items.title: Show HN: Free design canvas for your AI (open source)
items.contentSnippet:
Hey, sometimes it's easier to just move around some buttons in an editor instead of waiting a minute for the AI result.
E.g. take a screenshot of your UI, cut out a button, move it around to see what it looks like.
Your AI can send HTML into the editor, or screenshots.
Then you can edit it, move things around, and your AI takes it from there.
I've made it free and open source. You can build on top of it or improve it.
Comments URL: https://news.ycombinator.com/item?id=50150221
Points: 4

items.title: The School Choice Debate Looks Different From My Kitchen Table
items.contentSnippet: This op-ed from Georgetown, Texas mother Courtney Parker Lopez offers what the school choice debate almost never surfaces: a ground-level, human account of why one family left public school, how they navigated Texas's new education savings account program, and what it cost them emotionally before it ever cost the state a dollar. For education leaders and policymakers, it is a necessary reminder that the families most affected by these debates are rarely the ones shaping them. Parker Lopez writes

items.contentSnippet:
I made a tool to search and inspect Unicode characters in the terminal.
- Browse Unicode blocks or search by character, code point, or name
- View Unicode properties, encodings, and their descriptions
- Decompose strings into code points or grapheme clusters, and compare different normalization forms
- Preview glyphs using image display protocols (kitty, iTerm2)
